summary: Execute TileLang kernels through native Rust/khal Metal buffers and add same-GPU production Rust diagnostics.
regressions: all 17 existing portable cases through native Rust buffer loading
invalid or duplicate binding names, dispatch overflow and empty compiler bindings
unchanged adversarial suite compared with original Rust Metal solver
differences: Replaces the Swift replay process with a pinned Rust/khal adapter; the Python compiler remains build tooling. Dispatch is synchronous and flushes khal pending writes; this is not yet a selectable whole-scene backend.
Exports full Rust simulation parameters for original GPU reference replay without duplicating their arithmetic.
The production kernel cannot express the unbiased/no-friction combination; two cases are explicitly unavailable only in the diagnostic, and remain required in portable replay.
Same-GPU diagnostic failures remain failures. No tolerances or Rust physics were changed; the numerical release blocker remains.
